sentences.text:
Author: Joymalya Bagchi Bench: Joymalya Bagchi 07.10.2024 IN THE HIGH COURT AT CALCUTTA  Sl. No.8 Criminal Revisional Jurisdiction  akd  [Adjourned]
 C. R. R. 3648 of 2024  In Re: Goutam Ghosh & Ors.
 ... ... Petiti  Mr. Ranjeet Prasad  ... ... for the petitioners  1.
Petitioners submit they are the in-laws of the victim-housewife and did not ordinarily reside with her at the matrimonial home.
They have been falsely implicated at the behest of the victim.
2. I have considered the materials on record including the impugned charge sheet.
In the charge sheet it is contended on 05.03.2023 petitioners had assaulted the victim-housewife with fists and blows and on the next day all of them tried to set her on fire.
But in course of investigation no medical document supporting assault or attempt to set the housewife on fire were collected.
3. In view of the aforesaid, I am of the opinion petitioners have made out an arguable case in their favour.

4. Let a copy of the petition be served upon opposite party no.1-State through the learned Public Prosecutor, High Court, Calcutta and opposite party no.2 through Registered Speed Post with Acknowledgment Due and file affidavit-of-service on the next date of hearing.
5. Let the matter appear as 'Contested Application' four weeks after ensuing Puja Vacation.
6.

There shall be stay of the impugned proceeding being G.R. Case No.939 of 2023 arising out of Hariharpara Police Station Case No.92 of 2023 under Sections 498A/323/506/436/511/34 of the Indian Penal Code and Section 3 of the Dowry Prohibition Act pending before the learned Chief Judicial Magistrate, Murshidabad at Berhampore for a period of six weeks after ensuing Puja Vacation or until further orders, whichever is earlier.
